messages:
Maya (PM): Quick thread: were finalizing Launch Criteria for the New Microtier for embeddings. Key decision: free trial credits for microtier users - flat 500 embeddings vs proportional credits. Also need limits on per-account embedding rate.
Ravi / Sales: Field feedback: flat 500 is easy to communicate. Proportional credits tied to company size confuse reps. Keep it simple.
Clara (Finance): Flat credits OK, but we need to cap abuse. Recommend rate limit + requiring billing info after trial consumption.
Owen (SRE): Rate-limit suggestion: 10 embeddings/sec default, with soft throttle at 50/sec. Enforcement at edge proxy level.
Maya (PM): Proposed policy: 500 trial embeddings that expire in 30 days; per-account rate limit 10 rps by default; increase via verified billing. Launch checklist: docs, quota UI, telemetry, abuse mitigation, and messaging.
Ravi / Sales: Also need a pitch line for website and proposal snippets.
Maya (PM): Draft: "Try embeddings: 500 free embeddings for 30 days. Increase limits instantly with billing verification."
Clara (Finance): Add note for trials: trial usage converted to billable if billing info added; otherwise disabled after 30d.
Maya (PM): Cool. Filing PR with these constraints. Target: include microtier in next release. :rocket:
